note: PROTOTYPE — the logging viewer's key bindings, as data (architecture.md §5): change a key here, not in code. Shift is read by the action itself: Shift+←/→ scrubs 5 s instead of 10 frames, Shift+I/O marks the raw playhead, Shift+Tab selects the previous brick, Shift+Esc redoes. In the brick editor (P), Shift moves an edge one frame instead of one word. Revised from David's feedback, 2026-10-28.
